en.headline: Tourism minister says visitor spending reached HK$111 billion in first half
en.dek: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law told the Legislative Council that full-year related spending is projected at HK$238.1 billion after 11 per cent growth.
body: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law told the Legislative Council on Wednesday that visitors spent HK$111 billion in Hong Kong in the first half of 2026, an 11 per cent increase from the same period last year.

Law said the full-year figure for inbound tourism-related spending is projected to reach HK$238.1 billion. In the first 10 months of the year, about 45.8 million visitors arrived, up 12 per cent year on year.

She attributed the growth in part to mega-events, noting that overnight visitors in September and October totalled 3.72 million, a 6 per cent rise, with an average stay of 3.1 nights and third-quarter per-capita spending of about HK$5,400.

zh.headline: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指上半年旅客消費達1110億元
zh.dek: 羅淑佩向立法會表示，預計全年入境旅遊相關總消費將達2381億元，首十個月訪港人次按年升12%。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩周三在立法會表示，今年上半年與入境旅遊相關的總消費約1110億港元，按年上升11%。
羅淑佩指，預計全年相關總消費將進一步升至2381億港元。今年首十個月共有約4580萬人次旅客訪港，按年上升12%。
她表示盛事有助帶動消費，今年9月至10月過夜旅客約372萬人次，按年升6%，平均留港3.1晚，第三季過夜旅客人均消費約5400港元。
